The retained exact document_type is institutional_position; the only evidence for document_date 2023-06-14 gives it institutional-adoption meaning, not a separate document-issue meaning.
hold_reasons: The readiness compatibility rule does not permit document_date_kind institutional_adoption for the retained institutional_position type. No independent evidence establishes 14 June 2023 as a document-issue date, so relabelling the adoption date as document_issue would weaken the evidence gate; the record remains held pending a genuinely compatible evidenced date treatment.
